overview.ideasText: Keep each change small, testable and traceable. The dependency graph blocks unsafe execution order. AI helps articulate requirements; the backend validates the rules.

speech.unsupported: Speech recognition is not available in this browser. You can type instead.

specs.title: Specification registry
specs.empty: Complete an interview and generate your first spec drafts.
specs.draftsCreated_one: {{count}} draft created. Review it and approve it to push it to Git.
specs.draftsCreated_other: {{count}} drafts created. Review them and approve them to push them to Git.
specs.approveMessage: "{{title}}" is pushed to a new Git branch of the repository.
specs.approved: Spec pushed to branch {{branch}}. Merge it into the branch OpenJCockpit reads before dispatch.
specs.completed: Marked as done. Verify in OpenJCockpit first.
specs.fromInterview: Showing the specifications generated from this interview.
specs.bulkApproveMessage: Each spec is pushed to its own Git branch, in dependency order:
specs.bulkApproved_one: {{count}} spec pushed to Git. Merge its branch into the branch OpenJCockpit reads before dispatch.
specs.bulkApproved_other: {{count}} specs pushed to Git. Merge their branches into the branch OpenJCockpit reads before dispatch.

graph.title: Dependency graph
graph.hint: Arrows represent required predecessor completion, not simple associations.
graph.label: Spec dependency graph
graph.empty: No specifications yet. Generate your first interview.
graph.loadFailed: Failed to load the dependency graph.

queue.empty: Approve specs or finish their dependencies to enable dispatch.
queue.loadFailed: Failed to load the dispatch queue.
queue.hint: Dispatch is opt-in. Only ready, approved specs are sent. Dependent specs stay blocked until predecessors are done.
queue.published: The spec branches are merged into the branch that OpenJCockpit reads.
queue.unknownHint: Uncertain HTTP outcomes are recorded as UNKNOWN, never automatically retried.
queue.disabledNothingReady: Nothing to dispatch: no spec is ready yet.
queue.disabledNotPublished: Confirm that the spec branches are merged to enable dispatch.
queue.publishedHint: Approving only pushes a branch. OpenJCockpit reads the spec files from the target branch, so dispatching before the merge sends it files that are not there yet.

templates.name: Template name
templates.invalidJson: The questions are not valid JSON.
templates.specHint: Reusable Markdown structures for spec files, separate from the interview questionnaires. Placeholders: SPEC_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, TITLE, SUMMARY, DEPENDENCIES, ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.
templates.replaceMessage: Changing the interview type replaces the questions you edited with the sample questions of that type.

policy.loadFailed: Failed to load the policy settings.
policy.hint: When enabled, the Open Policy Agent decides on saving and checking repositories, approving specs and dispatching to OpenJCockpit. A denial shows the policy's reasons.
policy.readOnly: Only administrators can change these settings. You can view them.
policy.failOpen: Allow actions while the agent cannot be reached (fail open). Off: they are denied.
policy.savedOn: Saved. Repository changes, approvals and dispatches are now checked by the policies.
policy.standardHint: Shipped with Control Tower. Tune them in its policy data, or replace them with your own policies under the same decision path.

writerRoles.name: Writer roles.
writerRoles.text: Every governed action needs the operator or admin role, even if the backend role check is misconfigured.

gitHosts.name: Allowed Git hosts.
gitHosts.text: Repositories can only be saved or checked for approved Git hosts. An empty list allows every host.

fourEyes.name: Four-eyes approval.
fourEyes.text: The person who generated a spec may not approve it. Off by default.

acceptance.name: Acceptance criteria.
acceptance.text: A spec needs at least two acceptance criteria before it is approved.

secrets.name: Secret detection.
secrets.text: Specs that contain a private key or an access token are not pushed to Git.

freeze.name: Dispatch freeze.
freeze.text: Stops all dispatches to OpenJCockpit, for example during a release. Off by default.

dispatchRoles.name: Dispatch roles.
dispatchRoles.text: Only these roles may send specs to OpenJCockpit.
